name: Edge Preservation in Volume Rendering Using Splatting
definition: A method to preserve sharp edge details in splatting for volume rendering by applying a non-linear warping to the footprints of conventional splats and building a table of footprints for different possible edge positions and edge strengths.
summary: Edge Preservation in Volume Rendering Using Splatting preserves sharp details by applying non-linear warping to splat footprints, distinguishing itself by manipulating reconstruction kernels directly rather than deferring classification.
